package rules

import "errors"

var ErrRule = errors.New("invalid or stale game command")

type Command struct {
	Seq      uint64
	Revision uint64
	Kind     string
	Choice   int
}
type Result struct {
	Revision uint64
	Reward   int
}
type Receipt struct {
	Command Command
	Result  Result
}

// 状态整体放在生成 DAO，局内缓存不持有另一个可变副本；失败由正式 DAO undo 回滚。
type State struct {
	Members  []int64
	Revision uint64
	Last     map[int64]Receipt
	Turn     int
	HP       [2]int
	Deadline int64
	Finished bool
	Winner   int
}

func New(members []int64, now int64) (State, error) {
	if len(members) != 2 || members[0] <= 0 || members[1] <= 0 || members[0] == members[1] || now <= 0 {
		return State{}, ErrRule
	}
	return State{Members: append([]int64(nil), members...), Last: make(map[int64]Receipt), HP: [2]int{3, 3}, Deadline: now + 30000, Winner: -1}, nil
}
func (s *State) Apply(actor int64, cmd Command, now int64) (Result, error) {
	if len(s.Members) != 2 || s.Last == nil {
		return Result{}, ErrRule
	}
	index := -1
	for i, id := range s.Members {
		if id == actor {
			index = i
		}
	}
	if index < 0 || cmd.Seq == 0 {
		return Result{}, ErrRule
	}
	previous := s.Last[actor]
	if cmd.Seq == previous.Command.Seq {
		if cmd != previous.Command {
			return Result{}, ErrRule
		}
		return previous.Result, nil
	}
	if cmd.Seq != previous.Command.Seq+1 || cmd.Revision != s.Revision {
		return Result{}, ErrRule
	}
	reward, err := s.execute(index, cmd, now)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	s.Revision++
	result := Result{Revision: s.Revision, Reward: reward}
	s.Last[actor] = Receipt{Command: cmd, Result: result}
	return result, nil
}

// Timeout 是房间定时器的到期动作（game_room/timer_handlers.go）：期限到了才消费当前回合，与客户端上报的
// "timeout" 同一规则；修订号加一，按旧修订号准备的命令随之按过期拒绝。不记任何玩家的回执。
func (s *State) Timeout(now int64) error {
	if len(s.Members) != 2 || s.Last == nil || s.Finished || now < s.Deadline {
		return ErrRule
	}
	if _, err := s.execute(s.Turn, Command{Kind: "timeout"}, now); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.Revision++
	return nil
}

// 超时只消费当前回合，迟到动作不能顺带执行下一回合；调用者只能声明预期 revision。
func (s *State) execute(index int, cmd Command, now int64) (int, error) {
	if s.Finished {
		return 0, ErrRule
	}
	if cmd.Kind == "timeout" {
		if now < s.Deadline {
			return 0, ErrRule
		}
		s.HP[s.Turn]--
	} else {
		if cmd.Kind != "attack" || index != s.Turn || now >= s.Deadline || cmd.Choice != 0 {
			return 0, ErrRule
		}
		s.HP[1-index]--
	}
	if s.HP[0] == 0 || s.HP[1] == 0 {
		s.Finished = true
		s.Winner = 0
		if s.HP[0] == 0 {
			s.Winner = 1
		}
		return 0, nil
	}
	s.Turn = 1 - s.Turn
	s.Deadline = now + 30000
	return 0, nil
}
